title: Multi-Agent Scheduling Assistant
description: An autonomous multi-agent AI assistant for meeting scheduling, automated emails, and context-aware PDF RAG document conversations.
details: Built with Python, LangGraph, and FastAPI, this multi-agent assistant coordinates autonomous sub-agents to handle calendar scheduling, meeting notifications, and task orchestration. It integrates a RAG pipeline allowing users to upload internal company PDFs for context-grounded Q&A, backed by FAISS vector similarity and Google Gemini models.

title: AI Telegram Secretary (Agentic AI)
description: An intelligent Telegram productivity agent with LangGraph state workflows, SQLite persistent memory, and Google Workspace tool calling.
details: AI Telegram Secretary automates day-to-day executive assistance directly through Telegram. Powered by LangGraph and Gemini 2.5 Flash, it understands complex natural language prompts, interacts with Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Sheets APIs, and provides real-time weather and currency conversions via modular tool calling in FastAPI.

title: AI Stock Market Assistant with HITL
description: A LangGraph financial assistant featuring real-time stock analytics and Human-in-the-Loop approval workflows for simulated trading execution.
details: Engineered an agentic workflow with LangGraph and OpenAI GPT that performs live stock analysis and mock trade execution. Built an interrupt-driven Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval flow where high-stake decisions require explicit user confirmation. Features thread-based persistence using MemorySaver and an interactive Streamlit UI.

title: YouTube RAG Assistant
description: End-to-end RAG application extracting video transcripts, generating semantic embeddings, and answering user queries using Gemini 2.5 Flash.
details: Designed an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline using the YouTube Transcript API, recursive character text chunking, Hugging Face embeddings, and a FAISS vector index. Connected Gemini 2.5 Flash for grounded question-answering with timestamps, wrapped in a responsive Streamlit conversational interface.

title: Multitask AI-Powered Chatbot
description: ChatGPT-style intelligent agent with real-time web search, image generation, weather lookup, and multi-turn conversational memory.
details: A versatile AI agent architecture implemented using LangGraph, Google Gemini, and DuckDuckGo API. Supports multi-tool function calling to dynamically retrieve live web info, generate visuals, check stock updates, and recall previous interactions across user sessions.

title: AI Smart Interview System
description: Computer vision and LLM powered interview platform with facial authentication, voice Q&A, response scoring, and automated PDF reports.
details: Smart interview platform built with Python, OpenCV, and Groq API. Performs webcam-based face detection prior to the interview, dynamically generates domain-specific questions, accepts speech or text inputs, evaluates confidence and keywords, and compiles detailed performance reports with downloadable PDFs.

title: AI Career Guide & Resume Evaluator
description: Multi-model career assistance platform evaluating resumes, highlighting tech gaps, and creating personalized preparation roadmaps.
details: Full-stack web application built with Flask, SQLAlchemy, and multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek). Users upload resumes in PDF or DOCX format, run multi-model comparisons, inspect keyword coverage, and generate customized career roadmap recommendations.

title: AI Portfolio Assistant & Smart Scheduler
description: A modern portfolio platform featuring an integrated conversational AI chatbot with Cal.com API meeting scheduling and Google Meet sync.
details: Interactive Next.js platform integrating a custom AI assistant capable of answering technical inquiries and initiating autonomous booking flows. Features Cal.com API integration, automated confirmation emails, dynamic slot selection, and responsive dark-mode styling.
